chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 290: Li Huowang’s Brutal Mistake Against Blind Chen
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang tortures Blind Chen in a paranoid interrogation, only to discover he was wrong—while a Mud Bodhisattva and the Eighteen Arhats emerge from the temple.
og_title: Face-Peel Interrogation and a Coming Temple Horror
og_description: Li Huowang peels off a man’s face to confirm the truth, but his brutal mistake may cost them all when the temple’s guardians awaken.
twitter_title: Li Huowang Peels an Innocent Man’s Face in a Paranoia-Fueled Mistake
twitter_description: Blind Chen was telling the truth all along. Now the real threat is coming from the temple.

lore_anchors.definition: Spirits or entities that can be summoned with a Daoist bell; Li Huowang uses eight at once in this chapter.
A secret society of deceivers who weaponize lies and confusion; Li Huowang’s trauma with them drives his paranoia.
A government body that monitors supernatural activity; Li Huowang suspects the big-headed doll who recruited him may be a Zuowandao plant.
In Buddhism, the eighteen enlightened disciples of the Buddha, often depicted as guardian statues in temples. Here, they are corrupted, living clay shells with insect-like compound eyes.
A folk term for a bodhisattva idol that has been left in place so long it merges with the environment; in this novel, it is a silent, ominous watcher.
A spirit or protective immortal that Bai Lingmiao can invoke for healing; part of her chuma spirit-medium abilities.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Li Huowang peel Blind Chen’s face?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He was certain Chen was a Zuowandao shape-shifter hiding a second face beneath the first. The only way to prove it was to physically check—and he was wrong.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the big-headed doll from the Supervisory Heavenly Office actually a Zuowandao?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Not confirmed yet, but Li Huowang strongly suspects it after realizing Chen was telling the truth.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why don’t the Eighteen Arhats attack immediately?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They seem to be in a transitional state—emerging slowly from their mud shells. Their presence alone is a threat display.
